exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: A dumbbell sumo squat holds one dumbbell between the legs while the wide stance loads the hips and thighs.
instructions: Stand wide with toes turned outward and hold one dumbbell in front of the hips.
Brace the abdomen and lower by bending the hips and knees with the chest lifted.
Descend until the thighs approach parallel while the knees track the toes.
Drive through both feet to stand tall and keep the dumbbell centered.
common_mistakes: Letting the weight pull the torso forward.
source_english.safety_note: Use a dumbbell you can hold without rounding the back or losing balance.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Stand on one foot with a dumbbell near the thigh, hinge as the free leg reaches back, then stand and switch.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Using momentum instead of the target joint path.
source_english.safety_note: Keep the load close and stop if the spine cannot remain neutral.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: Upright Row (Dumbbell) pulls one dumbbell in each hand toward the upper chest with the elbows leading.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip at the thighs.
Brace the abdomen and pull the elbows upward and outward, keeping the load close to the body.
Stop when the hands reach the upper chest or before the shoulders pinch.
Lower the resistance slowly to the thighs and reset.
